classification_policy.required_for_v1: The design disposition must be represented in issue #39 and every stated implementation/release obligation must be satisfied before the autonomous MVP, unless a reviewed split moves an exact non-critical remainder after v1.
classification_policy.planned_after_v1: The capability is explicitly inactive in v1, remains mandatory for the full program, and starts at its recorded activation trigger after the autonomous MVP.
classification_policy.intentionally_deferred: Allowed only with an immutable external blocker or explicit user decision, complete risk/owner/return trigger, and no claim of full completion.
classification_policy.full_program_rule: The program continues after the autonomous MVP until all planned_after_v1 work is complete; intentionally_deferred is not completion without a later explicit user disposition.

records.issue_title: [P0] Создать полный migration/parity registry Traycer → autosk-flow
records.rationale: The migration registry is the only auditable inventory of Traycer guarantees and prevents silent loss during clean-room adaptation.
records.classification_risk: If it drifts or becomes incomplete, the program can claim parity while omitting a source capability.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Keep the merged registry/schema/validator authoritative and reference it from the capability matrix and later governance release work.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: No new runtime code is required by this issue; all subsequent parity claims must keep its validator green.
records.verification_expectation: Schema, coverage, privacy, digest and source-evidence tests remain green; any source addition without a registry record fails CI.

records.issue_title: [P0] Добавить human alignment gates перед Brief, Core Flow, Tech Plan и Tickets
records.rationale: Human alignment is required so model-generated framing, behavior, architecture and Ticket decomposition cannot become user authority by self-approval.
records.classification_risk: Without runtime enforcement, the design-only completion could be mistaken for an active safety boundary.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Carry the signed UserDecisionRecord, stale identity, policy scope and four named alignment lifecycles into the #39 design candidate.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement and test the four alignment gates, Quick→Planned reclassification, signed authority records and fail-closed resume behavior before MVP.
records.verification_expectation: E2E proves no normative artifact or Ticket Panel proceeds without current alignment or an exact permitted policy.

records.issue_title: [P0] Добавить Epic planning ref и commit-on-PASS для каждого планового артефакта
records.rationale: A private planning ref makes each approved artifact reachable, orders planning history and defines a stable planning_head for execution.
records.classification_risk: Without it, PASS snapshots can be garbage-collected, mixed in dirty worktrees or omitted from final delivery.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Specify commit-on-PASS, CAS publication, foreign movement, recovery phases and retention in the design candidate.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement crash-safe publication for every approved behavior artifact and use verified planning_head as the Ticket root.
records.verification_expectation: Fault tests cover crash before/after commit/CAS, retry, foreign movement, GC reachability and anchor rebuild descendants.

records.issue_title: [P0] Добавить канонический machine-readable Tickets manifest и JSON Schema
records.rationale: A strict Tickets manifest is the deterministic API between planning and the scheduler; Markdown alone cannot safely define a DAG.
records.classification_risk: Ambiguous prose can produce different graphs after restart or parser changes and hide unreviewed scope.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define schema, canonicalization, Markdown consistency, graph validation and candidate identity before #39.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Ship the versioned schema/validator and require one frozen manifest+docs candidate before Ticket Panel and dispatch.
records.verification_expectation: Negative tests cover IDs, cycles, dangling edges, path scope, AC/evidence mapping, unknown versions and canonical digests.

records.issue_title: [P0] Формировать execution base Ticket из approved transitive dependencies
records.rationale: Execution bases must include all approved transitive predecessors, otherwise blockers order time but dependent code still sees an obsolete tree.
records.classification_risk: Linear and diamond DAGs can compile against missing APIs or silently reimplement predecessor work.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define deterministic composition order, base identity, conflict handling, reachability and invalidation semantics.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Build and verify per-Ticket execution-base commits/trees before enrollment; invalidate descendants when a predecessor changes.
records.verification_expectation: Linear, diamond, overlapping-path, supersession, retry and worker-count tests produce identical verified trees.

records.issue_title: [P0] Заменить full-tree equality на approved-delta integration и перенести adversarial CAS test suite
records.rationale: Reviewed code must be integrated as an approved delta, not by comparing a later combined tree to one Ticket's complete tree.
records.classification_risk: Full-tree equality fails after the first independent Ticket; dropping the check would allow unreviewed conflict bytes.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define canonical delta entries, digest, apply proof, inherited Git environment neutralization and recovery classes.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement the autosk-owned adapter and port the Traycer adversarial CAS/reflog/obstruction/fault suite without runtime dependency.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover multiple Tickets, rename/mode/binary/symlink/submodule cases, foreign movement, indeterminate outcomes and every durable phase.

records.issue_title: [P0] Ввести private Epic staging ref и выполнять aggregate verification до final target CAS
records.rationale: Private Epic staging keeps the target unchanged until the complete combined state has aggregate evidence and current acceptance.
records.classification_risk: Integrating Tickets directly before aggregate verification can leave the user branch in a known-failing state.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Specify staging lineage, receipts, integration-fix lifecycle, aggregate binding, acceptance identity and single final CAS.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Apply reviewed deltas to staging, verify the exact staging state, then move target once under delivery policy.
records.verification_expectation: E2E proves aggregate failure never moves target and crash/retry around staging, acceptance and final CAS is idempotent.

records.issue_title: [P0] Закреплять extension/workflow code identity на весь Epic и добавить явную миграцию
records.rationale: Protocol pinning alone is insufficient because hot-reloaded extension code can change step semantics during an Epic.
records.classification_risk: An active Epic could execute half under old guards and half under new code while retaining a misleading old protocol lock.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define content-addressed distribution/runtime locks, graph/schema/helper digests, retention and migration receipts.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement exact runtime identity checks on dispatch/resume/transition and an explicit crash-safe migration path.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover same-version different bytes, hot reload, missing/corrupt old distribution, concurrent versions and migration rollback.

records.issue_title: [P0] Реализовать в autoskd атомарный creation_key + creation_binding_hash для idempotent child fan-out
records.rationale: Idempotent child fan-out needs daemon-owned creation identity that survives rename, partial setup and lost responses.
records.classification_risk: Editable title/metadata recovery can create duplicate or orphan Panel, Arena or Ticket tasks.

records.issue_title: [P0] Зафиксировать project instruction set и запретить неявную model-specific загрузку
records.rationale: All model families must receive one pinned project instruction set rather than provider-specific implicit AGENTS/CLAUDE context.
records.classification_risk: Hidden divergent instructions can invalidate cross-model comparisons and leak local or cross-project policy.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.

records.issue_title: [P0] Зафиксировать реализуемую safeProjectFs стратегию для macOS/Linux
records.rationale: The project promises race-resistant project ownership; that requires a concrete filesystem strategy on macOS and Linux.
records.classification_risk: Portable lexical checks can leave TOCTOU and symlink gaps or cause the runtime to fail closed on the user's Mac.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.

records.issue_title: [P0] Обобщить panel lifecycle на все behavior-defining artifacts

records.issue_title: [P0] Определить immutable task-store projection для параллельных gate-задач
records.rationale: Parallel reviewers need an immutable projection that excludes legitimate daemon progress while still detecting controlling-state mutation.
records.classification_risk: Hashing complete sibling files creates false failures; hashing too little permits invisible anchor or verdict tampering.

records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement pre/post projection and mutation provenance validation for every gate task.
records.verification_expectation: Concurrency tests vary seat completion order and host updates while detecting reviewer/driver mutation and schema mismatch.

records.issue_title: [P0] Реализовать canonical finding registry, merge/triage/contest и late-finding semantics
records.rationale: Panel and Code Review findings need deterministic provenance, triage, contest, Medium debt and late-finding semantics.
records.classification_risk: A free-form synthesis can drop, downgrade or close findings without evidence and cannot safely reopen a prior PASS.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define raw/canonical schemas, merge rules, citable dispositions, contest, gate predicate, debt and late finding flows.

records.issue_title: [P0] Добавить project delivery profile preflight: branch policy, CI, signatures, DCO и integration mode
records.rationale: Integration must match each repository's actual branch, PR, signing, CI and merge policy before implementation begins.
records.classification_risk: Individually reviewed commits may become undeliverable or require unreviewed history rewriting when policy is discovered late.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.

records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement local/PR delivery profiles needed by v1 and bind aggregate acceptance/final promotion to the current profile.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover protected and unprotected branches, PR-only, merge modes, signing/DCO, ruleset drift and unavailable discovery.

records.issue_title: [P0] Сделать все model-owned результаты структурированными, а transitions — host-mediated
records.rationale: Models should return closed structured outcomes while trusted host code validates identity/evidence and chooses exactly one transition.
records.classification_risk: Direct model transitions or task-store mutation create inconsistent trust and crash windows across providers.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.

records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement host-mediated results for every model-owned author, implementer, fixer, candidate and reviewer step.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать stage→protocol carrier matrix и attribution echo для каждого handoff
records.rationale: A stage-carrier matrix guarantees each role receives exactly the pinned protocol fragments it needs, with auditable attribution.
records.classification_risk: Sending every file bloats prompts; filesystem pointers or incomplete slices produce divergent, unprovable instructions.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Classify as v1-required and include carrier registry, attribution echo and bundle coverage contracts in the #39 design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement deterministic carrier resolution/serialization for all v1 roles and mark post-v1 mappings inactive but explicit.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover missing/forbidden fragments, stale echoes, ordering, prompt budgets, Judge secrecy and byte-identical Panel anchors.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить clearance manifest и fail-closed сканирование сериализованного handoff
records.rationale: Security checks must inspect the exact serialized handoff, including composed diagnostics and attributions, before any provider call.
records.classification_risk: Source-file scans can miss secrets or personal/client data introduced during prompt compilation or redaction.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Include exact-body clearance, scanner self-test, data policy and send-digest binding in the v1 design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement fail-closed secret/data clearance and sanitized evidence for every external provider dispatch.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover scanner failure, fake/real patterns, personal data, redaction, mutation between scan/send, binary input and stale exceptions.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить immutable snapshots и drift guard для внешних/non-Git источников
records.rationale: Non-Git uploads and external specifications require immutable project-owned snapshots because Git OIDs do not bind live mutable sources.
records.classification_risk: Different seats could review different bytes, and a passed source could later disappear or drift.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define source kinds, copy/identity receipts, storage/retention, drift and supersession semantics before #39.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement snapshot mint/check for v1-supported text and binary inputs before they can enter an anchor pack.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover modification/deletion/symlink swap, binary/PDF/image bytes, concurrency, corruption, dedup and pre-PASS drift.

records.issue_title: [P1] Портировать verified artifact writes: receipts, quarantine и reconciliation
records.rationale: Canonical artifacts need verified writes with read-back receipts, quarantine and reconciliation rather than optimistic file writes.
records.classification_risk: Crashes, formatters or concurrent writers can make metadata claim bytes that do not exist at the trusted destination.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define write phases, receipts, quarantine, reconciliation truth and safeProjectFs use in the design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement host-owned verified writes for every canonical artifact/manifest/lock created by v1.
records.verification_expectation: Fault tests cover disk/permission failure, crash around fsync/rename/receipt, external mutation, special/oversized files and conflicts.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать project verification doc workflow по protocol/verification/template.md
records.rationale: A project verification document makes behavioral evidence reproducible and binds Tickets to named launch/drive/evidence/cleanup recipes.
records.classification_risk: Green ad-hoc commands may not prove user behavior and can drift without detection.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Include verification-doc artifact class, feature-map schema, self-proof and Ticket linkage in the v1 design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement recipe generation/validation/self-proof and require mapped evidence before Ticket acceptance.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover fresh projects, missing/drifted recipes, wrong surfaces, infrastructure failures, cleanup and evidence redaction.

records.issue_title: [P1] Сделать work-type playbooks исполняемыми prerequisites и evidence gates
records.rationale: Work-type playbooks must be executable prerequisites and evidence gates rather than prose that a model may ignore.
records.classification_risk: Bug fixes, refactors and performance work can appear green without root cause, behavior pin or predeclared measurement method.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define typed work-type fields, mixed-work split rules and pre/post validators before #39.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement feature, bug-fix, refactoring and performance gates in manifest dispatch, result validation and review identity.
records.verification_expectation: Per-type positive/negative matrices cover stale evidence, wrong surface, exceptions, mixed types and provider success without proof.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать requirement revision propagation: product → technical → Tickets → implemented work
records.rationale: Requirement revision must update product intent before technical design, Tickets and already implemented work dispositions.
records.classification_risk: A mechanically consistent anchor rebuild can preserve the wrong meaning if semantic ordering is absent.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define revision classification, user decisions, layered re-panels, consistency sweep and staged/integrated dispositions.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement the semantic revision front-end and connect its approved impact plan to crash-safe rebuild operations.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover product/technical/security changes at every lifecycle point, rapid supersession and defer/new-Epic/rework decisions.

records.issue_title: [P1] Усилить provider preflight: exact route/effort, capability isolation, time budgets и failure domains
records.rationale: Exact route, effort, capability, timeout and failure-domain policy is required to make four-family gates truthful and recoverable.
records.classification_risk: Providers may silently downgrade effort, hang, leak capabilities or make multiple routes unavailable through one harness.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Include capability registry, attestable/residual fields, bounded retries and process lifecycle in the v1 design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement preflight/runtime enforcement for all v1 model routes without silent substitution or effort downgrade.
records.verification_expectation: Fake-provider tests cover model/effort drop, auth, timeout/orphans, session corruption, permission rejection and shared-domain outage.

records.issue_title: [P1] Определить evidence lifecycle: schema, redaction, retention, tombstones и durable/transient classes
records.rationale: PASS and recovery depend on durable evidence with explicit privacy, retention, reference and tombstone semantics.
records.classification_risk: Cleanup can erase proof, sensitive raw output can persist indefinitely, and corrupt evidence may go unnoticed.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define evidence classes, manifests, retention locks, redaction, dependent invalidation and repair before #39.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement durable/transient evidence lifecycle for v1 gates, verification, integration, approvals and cleanup.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover active-reference expiry, corruption, redaction failure, size/truncation, concurrent cleanup and cross-project injection.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать autosk-native Autobuild Generator/Evaluator workflow
records.rationale: Autobuild is an advanced opt-in Generator/Evaluator loop and is not required to prove the core Planned/Quick autonomous MVP.
records.classification_risk: Deferring it means hands-off iterative build campaigns remain unavailable at v1, but core correctness and manual Ticket orchestration remain intact.
records.activation_trigger: Begin after issue #36 closes and the autonomous MVP release is attested.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 mark the workflow and bundled protocol as inactive_in_v1 with an explicit post-v1 contract and no readiness claim.

records.verification_expectation: Post-v1 E2E covers immutable contract, budgets/no-progress, generator/evaluator independence, crash recovery and normal gates.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать Reflect + cost-watch для управляемой эволюции governance
records.rationale: Reflect and cost-watch govern long-term protocol evolution but are not required for the first correct autonomous workflow release.
records.classification_risk: Without it v1 relies on manual retrospectives and governance growth is not automatically measured.
records.activation_trigger: Begin after issue #36 closes and at least one completed Epic provides retrospective evidence.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 document inactive_in_v1 status and the rule that no automatic governance mutation is implied.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: None before MVP; after #36 implement sanitized retrospectives, cost-watch and panel-governed bundle changes.
records.verification_expectation: Post-v1 tests cover concurrent append, malformed/truncated history, speculative rules, evidence locators and keep/relax/remove history.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить безопасный Housekeeping workflow для worktrees, snapshots и orphan state
records.rationale: Housekeeping is an operator convenience for stale/orphan state; safe end-of-Epic cleanup and retention correctness remain v1 requirements elsewhere.
records.classification_risk: Operators may need manual cleanup after v1, but deferring automated inventory is safer than shipping premature destructive logic.
records.activation_trigger: Begin after issue #36 closes and safeProjectFs/evidence retention are proven in production-like E2E.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 distinguish mandatory scoped cleanup from the inactive post-v1 host-wide Housekeeping workflow.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: None before MVP beyond safe scoped cleanup; after #36 implement inventory/classification/approval/revalidation deletion.
records.verification_expectation: Post-v1 adversarial tests cover in-use, dirty, detached, submodule, orphan, unknown and report-to-delete races.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить отдельный Debate workflow для non-empirical one-way-door решений
records.rationale: Debate addresses non-empirical one-way-door trade-offs and is optional beyond the core alignment/Panel/Arena lifecycle.
records.classification_risk: V1 must escalate such questions to a human without structured multi-perspective debate.
records.activation_trigger: Begin after issue #36 closes or earlier only by explicit user request for the Debate capability.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 mark Debate inactive_in_v1 and preserve the human-decision fallback without false capability claims.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: None before MVP; after #36 implement two approval gates, participant rounds, mediator synthesis and impact handoff.
records.verification_expectation: Post-v1 tests cover roster/route rejection, persistent disagreement, caps, false consensus, secrecy and Arena-vs-Debate classification.

records.issue_title: [P1] Перенести bounded loop protocol и четыре обязательных escalation trigger
records.rationale: A bounded iteration controller prevents repeated no-op attempts and forces escalation on invalid premise, out-of-scope decisions or missing permission.
records.classification_risk: Without it implementation can exhaust provider budgets or mutate scope while appearing to make progress.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Include iteration schema, progress identity, four triggers and crash-safe counters in the v1 design.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement the controller across planning repair, debugging, implementation, fix and verification support.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover repeated errors, new hypotheses, no-op edits, each escalation trigger, provider retry distinction and crash/cap behavior.

records.issue_title: [P2] Добавить user-approved Changeset Walkthrough, привязанный к final staging identity
records.rationale: Changeset Walkthrough is explanatory UX after a verified result and does not participate in correctness of the core release.
records.classification_risk: Users will not receive an auto-generated semantic review guide in v1, but all canonical evidence remains accessible.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить `autosk-flow doctor` для fail-fast проверки проекта, runtime и recovery state
records.rationale: A single doctor command reuses preflight checks and makes complex capability/recovery failures diagnosable before side effects.
records.classification_risk: Without it release readiness and operator recovery fragment across opaque runtime failures.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.

records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement doctor for autoskd, locks, filesystem, provider, Git/delivery, clearance, evidence and recovery state.

records.issue_title: [P1] Добавить human decision queue и детерминированный status/reporting contract
records.rationale: Human parks require structured decision requests and status projections so users can safely answer the current identity rather than arbitrary comments.
records.classification_risk: Stale or ambiguous responses can resume the wrong operation, and multi-project progress becomes opaque.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define HumanDecisionRequest, immutable answer, status snapshot, staleness and idempotent resume before #39.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement CLI/API decision queue and status projection for every v1 human gate and recovery path.

records.issue_title: [P0] Добавить clean-room E2E: полный flow без Traycer, multi-project isolation и crash recovery
records.rationale: The clean-room suite is the only end-to-end proof that autonomy, isolation and crash recovery work without Traycer or real credentials.

records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 finalize the test architecture and fault matrix as a mandatory release gate, without requiring runtime code yet.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: After implementation, pass the full Planned/Quick/multi-project/fault matrix on macOS and supported Linux before MVP release.
records.verification_expectation: One canonical CI command proves exact refs/trees/locks/receipts/evidence and negative no-Traycer assertions.

records.issue_title: [P1] Реализовать governance bundle import/build/release lifecycle с аттестацией
records.rationale: The autonomous governance bundle needs a reproducible import/adapt/build/review/release lifecycle and version retention.
records.classification_risk: Copying files manually can ship Traycer-specific commands, forged attestations or latest bytes into pinned Epics.
records.activation_trigger: Active in the v1 program; execute when all listed dependencies and the current phase gate are satisfied.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Define source/adaptation/release separation, canonical build, panel attestation, CAS current pointer and rollback/retention.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: Implement the governance CLI/pipeline and release the exact v1 bundle used by clean-room E2E.
records.verification_expectation: Tests cover reproducible builds, path/line ending order, leaks, panel fixes, release conflicts, old locks and forged/corrupt attestations.

records.issue_title: [P2] Расширить autosk extension SDK типизированным write API и убрать CLI из correctness-critical paths
records.rationale: A complete typed extension write API is a post-MVP control-plane improvement when the accepted v1 primitives can be proven through narrower daemon APIs.
records.classification_risk: Keeping CLI boundaries longer increases parsing/process complexity; if any v1 atomic guarantee cannot be met, the necessary subset must be promoted before MVP.
records.owner: autosk upstream and extension SDK maintainers
records.activation_trigger: Begin after issue #36 closes; promote an exact subset earlier if a v1 atomic guarantee cannot be implemented safely without it.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Before #39 document the conditional escalation rule and ensure v1 never relies on a human-oriented untyped outcome for correctness.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: None by default before MVP; immediately split/promote any required typed primitive that #11/#18 or another accepted contract cannot safely provide.
records.verification_expectation: Post-v1 tests cover CAS, idempotency, transaction failure, capability scope, daemon restart and CLI/SDK semantic parity.

records.issue_title: [P0][DESIGN GATE] Пересобрать спецификацию и получить новый four-model PASS после архитектурных dispositions
records.rationale: A fresh exact four-model design PASS is required because accepted hardening changes invalidate the historical candidate's assurance.
records.classification_risk: Beginning implementation from mixed old documents and new issues would create an unreviewed architecture and circular assumptions.
records.activation_trigger: Run after all Group A design dispositions, mixed prerequisite design contracts, and this capability matrix are frozen.
records.design_obligation_before_issue_39: Freeze one internally consistent design candidate after all required design dispositions and publish a full attestation.
records.implementation_obligation_before_mvp: No product runtime implementation is owned here; implementation backlog may start only after this gate closes.
records.verification_expectation: GPT/Grok/Kimi/Opus review one exact tree, all Critical/High close, every Medium is fixed or explicitly deferred, and attestation is schema-valid.
